name: Entity to Text - Tika
description: Provides the utility APIs to transforms Files to Text.
project_description: Submodule of Entity to Text. Provides utility APIs to extract plain text from managed files via an Apache Tika server (entity_to_text_tika.extractor.file_to_text), an on-disk OCR cache under private:// (entity_to_text_tika.storage.local_file), a PreProcessFileEvent to alter the Tika client/file before extraction, and a Drush command (drush e2t:t:w) to warm the OCR cache. The Tika host/port are read from settings.php ($settings['entity_to_text_tika.connection']). Requires the base entity_to_text module, core file, the vaites/php-apache-tika library, and a reachable Tika server.
